raw_text: {"overall_diagnosis":"The failures consistently indicate problems editing an embedded Excel workbook inside a PPTX. The agent likely updated the target exchange-rate cell but did not preserve workbook/value integrity during save or repack, causing unrelated numeric cells to appear blank/NaN to the verifier and leaving the reciprocal/inverse rate unresolved. The recurring gap across samples is missing workflow guidance for safely modifying embedded XLSX objects in PPTX while preserving all unaffected cells, formulas, cached values, relationships, and extraction compatibility.","diagnosed_skills":[{"path":"xlsx/SKILL.md","confidence":"0.86","diagnosis":"The workbook-edit workflow lacks explicit guidance for minimal-diff updates in embedded Excel files. Failures suggest that editing/saving introduced blank or non-numeric stored values, failed to preserve formulas or cached results, and did not correctly handle reciprocal/inverse-rate cells that may be either formulas or hardcoded constants. Current guidance also does not address verifier behaviors that read stored values via openpyxl/pandas without recalculation.","repair_instruction":"Add a dedicated section for editing embedded Office workbooks safely. Instruct agents to load the workbook with openpyxl, modify only intended cells, preserve formulas/styles/shared strings, and avoid operations that rewrite or clear unrelated cells. Require checking whether reciprocal/inverse cells are formulas or constants: preserve formulas exactly, but explicitly update hardcoded inverse values to 1/rate with appropriate rounding. Add guidance on workbook recalculation metadata and preserving cached formula values when downstream extractors may not recalculate. Include a validation workflow comparing pre/post cell grids to ensure all previously populated numeric cells remain unchanged except intended edits and that no cells become None/blank/NaN."},{"path":"pptx/SKILL.md","confidence":"0.78","diagnosis":"The PPTX guidance covers unpacking OOXML but lacks practical instructions for safely editing embedded Excel/OLE objects under ppt/embeddings and repacking presentations without breaking extraction compatibility. The observed NaNs imply the embedded workbook or related PPTX parts/relationships were altered inconsistently during repackaging.","repair_instruction":"Add explicit workflow guidance for embedded Excel objects in PPTX: locate embedded workbooks in ppt/embeddings and associated relationship files, edit only the embedded XLSX bytes, preserve all non-target PPTX parts and relationships, and avoid repack steps that rename, omit, or recompress parts incompatibly. Document how to verify whether cached table/chart representations or alternate embedded data need synchronization. Add post-edit validation steps that re-extract the embedded workbook from the rebuilt PPTX and compare cell-by-cell against the original to confirm only intended cells changed and all other numeric values remain intact."}],"unselected_skills":[]}
